name: Haley Ranger
source: Haley had dreamed of being a sorceress since childhood, even though she was born into a family of ordinary people. Her dream came true when she received a letter from Cordale, and now she's living a dream. She loves reading and learning new things, can't resist riddles, and is always ready to participate in any adventure.
